name: viewer-types
title: Viewer Types
author: MR <contact@bimframe.co>
description: Typed surface for the Autodesk Viewer global runtime — Autodesk's official @types/forge-viewer definitions re-exported under stable APS* names, plus domain types for cameras, properties, extensions, and promise-based token callbacks.
docs: Types come from Autodesk's official @types/forge-viewer package (installed as a dev dependency), which declares the global Autodesk namespace plus a bundled minimal THREE namespace. lib/forge-viewer.d.ts adds the few members the official definitions miss (Profile, ProfileSettings, setProfile). If your tsconfig sets an explicit "types" array, add "forge-viewer" to it.
